sentences.quote: Ghazi worked with de Geus and the leadership team for 25+ years, most recently as COO and President, and he has led their AI journey via Synopsys.ai beginning in 2017. Before joining Synopsys in 1998 as an applications engineer, he began his career as a design engineer at Intel.
sentences.text: Ghazi began his career as a design engineer at Intel before joining Synopsys in 1998 as an applications engineer, and he worked alongside de Geus and the leadership team for more than 25 years, most recently as President and COO, while leading the company's AI journey through Synopsys.ai from 2017.

As CEO he has continued de Geus's strategy and long-term vision, with capital allocation focused on reinvestment in the business, typically tuck-in M&A and opportunistic buybacks; buybacks are currently paused to pay down debt from the $35bn Ansys acquisition until leverage falls below 1x debt to adjusted EBITDA.
